simple.meaning: גִּילֹנִי (Gîylônîy) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a Gilonite or inhabitant of Giloh.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.

definitions.short: a Gilonite or inhabitant of Giloh
definitions.full: H1526. Giloni גִּילֹנִי adjective, of a people 2Sam 15:12 , 23:34 = 1Chr 11:36 , where also read ׳הַגּ (for הַמְּלֹנִי ᵑ0 ). גִּיגַת see below גנן . גיר ( boil, boil up ? compare Aramaic גִּיר wave , Late Hebrew id. foam ; Arabic quicklime , also heat in chest from rage or hunger (Lane); admodum aestuans according to Fl NHWB i. 433 b ; but compare below)

occurrences.englishText: Absalom sent for Ahithophel the Gilonite, David’s counselor, from his city, even from Giloh, while he was offering the sacrifices. The conspiracy was strong; for the people increased continually with Absalom.
Eliphelet the son of Ahasbai, the son of the Maacathite, Eliam the son of Ahithophel the Gilonite,
